hero.h1: Meknes, Volubilis & Moulay Idriss Day Trip
hero.lead: Fes → Meknes → Volubilis Roman Ruins → Moulay Idriss Zerhoun → Fes

paras: The single most popular history day trip from Fes and our best-value route — three sites in one shared group day: the imperial city of Meknes, the exceptionally preserved Roman ruins at Volubilis, and the hillside holy town of Moulay Idriss Zerhoun.

Because all three stops sit close together, this is also our shortest full-day route from Fes — a lower price for a route packed with history, including Volubilis's remarkably intact 2,000-year-old floor mosaics.
chips: 🚗 ≈190 km round trip · about 3.5 hrs driving

includes: Guided stops at all three sites

paras: Because the three stops are close together, this is one of our shortest full days on the road — great if you want a lot of history without a long drive.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Is Volubilis worth the entrance fee?
items.a: Yes — it's one of Morocco's best-preserved Roman sites, with mosaics still visible in situ. The stop is roughly 45 minutes to an hour.
Yes, the town itself is open to all visitors — only the shrine's inner sanctuary is restricted to Muslims. The hillside views are the highlight for most travelers.

items.q: Is this a good first day trip from Fes?
items.a: Yes — it's our shortest full-day route, making it an easy, low-cost introduction to day trips before a longer one like Chefchaouen.
